source: Stanford Digital Economy Lab and ADP Research, AI Economic Indicators: Canaries Dashboard
citation: Stanford Digital Economy Lab and ADP Research. "AI Economic Indicators: Canaries Dashboard."
license: No licence is stated by the publisher; the dashboard page gives a citation format and links general terms of use.
note: Employment index by occupational AI-exposure quintile and age band, 2022-11 = 100, from anonymised ADP payroll records for a rolling five-year balanced panel of firms. Exposed = the two most exposed quintiles, control = the three least, which is the paper's own grouping. Each side is the equal-weight mean of its quintile series. The year-over-year figures are the publisher's, not recomputed. The sample is not representative of the US labour market, occupations are weighted equally rather than by employment, and history revises with every vintage. No pre-2020 history exists, so this panel carries no baseline z-score.
